verification_gate.HISTORICAL_UNIVERSE: Declare requested as-of coverage [start,end) first (owner has not specified a window). Obtain the complete provider-listed eligible expiry set at every T, including maturities beyond end for NEXT; include additions, withdrawals and corrections. Do not derive a weekday/monthly list.
verification_gate.TRADING_CALENDAR: Archive official venue/segment trading dates, holidays, special sessions, emergency closures and dated contract-rule changes. Observed candle days or another exchange holiday list are insufficient.
verification_gate.PUBLICATION_LISTING: Retain original provider response/master/document bytes, source locator, capture/publication timestamps with timezone, each contract listing/delisting timestamp, effective interval, version, completeness proof, and SHA-256. Publication by T must be proved independently of a later download.
verification_gate.EXPIRY_CUTOFF: Obtain official last-trading date and exact time/timezone for each option contract, including holiday shifts/amendments. Do not assume 15:30, end-of-day, or futures expiry minus a business-day count.
verification_gate.DHAN_IDENTITY: Archive Dhan instrument/underlying security IDs and segment mapping for the historical interval and original full expiry-list responses. Current successful live lists cannot establish past availability.
verification_gate.ANGEL_IDENTITY: Archive AngelOne instrument master versions with token, name, instrumenttype, exchange segment, option expiry and publication/listing evidence. An individual captured option subset is not a complete calendar.
verification_gate.MCX_UNDERLYING: For each main/mini product separately, prove the option-to-underlying-future mapping, dated futures security/token IDs and option cutoff. A futures expiry or main-contract calendar alone is insufficient for the option/mini.
verification_gate.INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: An independent reviewer must compare every normalized field and completeness/temporal claim to retained source bytes; record reviewer, review date, locator, hashes and signed/traceable disposition. Never mark VERIFIED based on code comments, schema validity or synthetic tests.
verification_gate.LIFECYCLE: Obtain dated launch, cessation, rename/restructure, weekly/monthly introduction/withdrawal and contract amendment notices; link old/new IDs only when officially proved. Record NOT_APPLICABLE only with evidence, never from absence.
verification_gate.METALS_SUPPORT: Registry FUTURE identity is not proof of provider historical listing or option support. Obtain separate FUTURE universe/cutoffs; prove any OPTION type/feed before adding it. Mini and main are distinct.
